ai.pattern.PAT-001.title: Recovery plan for overdue tasks
ai.pattern.PAT-001.issue: The project has {overdue_tasks} overdue task(s), which may affect the committed schedule.
ai.pattern.PAT-001.description: Create a concrete recovery action from the internal AI engine.
ai.pattern.PAT-002.title: Escalate project to Critical status
ai.pattern.PAT-002.issue: The calculated end date exceeds the contractual date by {contractual_delay_days} day(s).
ai.pattern.PAT-002.description: Make the contractual deviation visible and activate recovery governance.
ai.pattern.PAT-003.title: Complete mitigation plan for high risks
ai.pattern.PAT-003.issue: There are {risks_without_mitigation} high risk(s) without a mitigation plan.
ai.pattern.PAT-003.description: Reduce probability or impact before the risk materializes.
ai.pattern.PAT-004.title: Complete contingency plan for high risks
ai.pattern.PAT-004.issue: There are {risks_without_contingency} high risk(s) without a contingency plan.
ai.pattern.PAT-004.description: Prepare a concrete response if the risk materializes.
ai.pattern.PAT-005.title: Create financial risk for budget vs progress deviation
ai.pattern.PAT-005.issue: Executed budget exceeds physical progress by {budget_progress_gap} percentage point(s).
ai.pattern.PAT-005.description: Activate financial control and containment actions.
ai.pattern.PAT-006.title: Request evidence for committed deliverables
ai.pattern.PAT-006.issue: There are {deliverables_missing_evidence} deliverable(s) with missing evidence.
ai.pattern.PAT-006.description: Improve traceability and support for deliverable closure.
ai.pattern.PAT-007.title: Escalate blocking dependencies
ai.pattern.PAT-007.issue: There are {blocked_dependencies} blocked dependency/dependencies that may affect work.
ai.pattern.PAT-007.description: Accelerate decisions and unblock successor tasks.
ai.pattern.PAT-008.title: Rebalance overloaded resources
ai.pattern.PAT-008.description: Reduce bottlenecks and improve critical task compliance.
ai.pattern.PAT-009.title: Formalize change control record
ai.pattern.PAT-009.issue: There are {scope_change_requests} scope change request(s) requiring formal control.
ai.pattern.PAT-009.description: Control impact on time, cost, scope, and approval.
ai.pattern.PAT-010.title: Escalate blockers reported in conversations
ai.pattern.PAT-010.description: Turn informal signals into visible, traceable actions.
ai.pattern.PAT-011.title: Review sprint capacity and scope
ai.pattern.PAT-011.issue: The Scrum velocity gap is {sprint_velocity_gap} point(s).
ai.pattern.PAT-011.description: Adjust sprint commitments and reduce delivery risk.
ai.pattern.PAT-012.title: Executive follow-up for high risks
ai.pattern.PAT-012.issue: There are {high_risks_with_plans} active high risk(s) with mitigation and contingency defined.
ai.pattern.PAT-012.description: Maintain executive visibility without duplicating existing plans.
ai.pattern.NO-ACTION.title: Keep ordinary project monitoring
ai.pattern.NO-ACTION.issue: No real deviations requiring corrective action were detected.
ai.pattern.NO-ACTION.description: Maintain traceability without creating unnecessary tasks.
ai.health.En observación.summary: 项目出现轻微信号，需要预防性跟进。
ai.health.Crítico.summary: 项目存在累计、合同或高影响偏差，需要执行层升级处理。

agile.modeHelp.Scrumban: Combines a work list, optional cycles, and flow limits.
agile.modeHelp.H\u00edbrido: Connects agile execution with Master Plan, PMO, risks, budget, and AI.
